cohort: The participants were pregnant women with gestational diabetes mellitus (GDM), hypertensive disorders in pregnancy (HDP), and healthy pregnant women.
finding: Altered gut microbiota before 20 weeks of gestation precedes clinical signs of GDM and HDP, with specific species and compositions of Actinobacteria, Bacteroidetes, and Synergistes being associated with these metabolic diseases.
cross-section timing: Feces were collected before 20 weeks of pregnancy for microbiota analysis.
